videos.title: Alerta Aeropuerto: Lima
videos.description: Los agentes detienen a un pasajero español al descubrir que cada elemento de sus maletas, desde ropa a productos alimenticios, lleva un inesperado contenido oculto: cocaína. El cargamento termina sumando casi 10 kilogramos.

videos.title: Alerta Aeropuerto: Lima
videos.description: La Policía Antidrogas deberá detectar estupefacientes hábilmente escondidos en el equipaje, cargamentos ilegales escondidos en bloques de metal e incluso mujeres que arriesgan sus propias vidas para transportar cocaína en sus organismos.

videos.title: Alerta Aeropuerto: Lima
videos.description: Los agentes descubren irregularidades en una maleta gracias a los rayos X. Los agentes encuentran paquetes en la estructura de la maleta de dos pasajeras colombianas, un total de casi 16 kilogramos de cocaína.

videos.title: Alerta Aeropuerto: Lima
videos.description: En el Jorge Chávez, todo puede suceder... pasajeros que intentan transportar sustancias ilícitas en su equipaje o en sus organismos, encomiendas con droga oculta en sus estructuras o impregnadas en telas, e incluso ancianas de inocente apariencia.

videos.title: Alerta Aeropuerto: Lima
videos.description: En el Aeropuerto Jorge Chávez, las oficiales enfrentan los más osados intentos de tráfico de drogas, desde equipajes con doble fondo hasta cocaína camuflada en empaques de alimentos.

videos.title: Alerta Aeropuerto: Lima
videos.description: Los agentes reciben una alerta de una maleta que presenta una estructura anormal, y como el dueño ya ha abordado, deben demorar la salida del avión y examinar su equipaje en la manga hasta encontrar lo que podría ser un cargamento de cocaína. Además, los agentes descubren sustancias ilícitas en las botellas de gaseosas y chicha morada que lleva un pasajero y más tarde detectan que otra persona pretende traficar drogas utilizando la misma modalidad. Una mujer se muestra excesivamente nerviosa.

videos.title: Alerta Aeropuerto: Lima
videos.description: Los agentes interceptan a una pasajera sospechosa que viaja con su hija de cinco años. La madre podría quedar detenida.

videos.title: Alerta Aeropuerto: Lima
videos.description: La Policía Antidrogas del Aeropuerto Jorge Chávez de Lima, Perú, confronta a una pasajera que lleva cocaína introducida en su cuerpo. Y un pasajero intenta intimidar a los agentes con falsas declaraciones.

videos.title: Alerta Aeropuerto: Lima
videos.description: Un hombre engaña a su pareja para que lleve droga en su maleta y convierte unas supuestas vacaciones románticas en una pesadilla. Un pasajero transporta cocaína en paquetes alimenticios y otro la lleva meticulosamente oculta en su ropa.

videos.title: Alerta Aeropuerto: Lima
videos.description: Un hombre engaña a su amigo que sin saberlo transporta cocaína en su equipaje, una pareja es descubierta con droga en cuatro maletas con un sofisticado doble fondo y un joven lleva marihuana aduciendo que es para consumo personal.

videos.title: Alerta Aeropuerto: Lima
videos.description: Un hombre lleva veinte tapetes de piel de alpaca aduciendo que son souvenirs cuando, en realidad, llevan droga en su interior. Una joven lleva narcóticos en el doble fondo de su maleta.

videos.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
videos.description: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

videos.title: Furlough
videos.description: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip.

videos.title: Fist Fight
videos.description: On the last day before summer vacation, high school teacher Andy Campbell tries his best to keep it together amid senior pranks, a dysfunctional administration and budget cuts that threaten his job. Things go from bad to worse when he crosses Ron Strickland, the school's toughest and most feared teacher. When Strickland gets fired, he challenges Campbell to a fight after school. As news of the showdown spreads like wildfire, poor Andy desperately seeks any way out of his date with certain doom.

videos.title: Baby Driver
videos.description: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

videos.title: Gravity
videos.description: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalski, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space.

videos.title: Patriot Games
videos.description: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller.

videos.title: V for Vendetta
videos.description: Following the world war, London is a police state occupied by a fascist government, and a vigilante known only as V uses terrorist tactics to fight the oppressors of the world in which he now lives. When V saves a young woman named Evey from the secret police, he discovers an ally in his fight against England's oppressors.

videos.title: Apocalypse Now Redux
videos.description: Secret ops assassin Captain Willard (Martin Sheen) is sent on a mission up a river during the Vietnam War to "terminate with extreme prejudice" the errant Colonel Kurtz (Marlon Brando). In addition to being re-edited with the new footage, the film has been completely restored, converted to digital, and reprinted by dye-transfer, improving color reproduction.

videos.title: Godzilla
videos.description: Ford Brody (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco when he is forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe (Bryan Cranston). Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake, as they make their way toward their final battleground: San Francisco.
